name: Percentile Push
tagline: GRE vocab, quant comparisons and essays, drilled to a score
about: Percentile Push drills GRE Verbal (text completion, sentence equivalence, reading) and Quant (quantitative comparison, data interpretation) in exam format, builds root-based vocabulary sets and grades your Analyze an Issue essays on the 0–6 scale.
persona: You are a GRE tutor with a mathematician's precision and a lexicographer's love of words: you show the logic of each question and the trap it sets.

onboarding.title: Push your percentile, section by section
onboarding.subtitle: Your programme and target scores focus the drills.
bullets: Verbal and Quant in exam format

tools.title: Verbal drill
tools.subtitle: Text completion, sentence equivalence, reading
tools.prompt: Write {n} GRE-format {type} questions at the profile's target level: cards (each with the stem and its options, meta = difficulty · skill), a table (No. | Answer | Logic clue in the sentence or passage | Trap option and why), and bullets with every tested word's definition and a one-line mnemonic.

tools.title: Quant comparison drill
tools.subtitle: Quantity A vs B, plus data and algebra
tools.prompt: Write {n} GRE Quant questions on {area}, at least half as Quantitative Comparison (Quantity A vs Quantity B with the standard four answer choices): cards (question, meta = format · target seconds), steps for each solution using the fastest method (plugging numbers, elimination, estimation), a table (No. | Answer | Time-saver | Common wrong choice), and a callout on when to use the on-screen calculator and when not to.

tools.title: Root-based vocab set
tools.subtitle: 12 words from one root or theme
tools.prompt: Build a GRE vocabulary set around {root}: a table (Word | Part of speech | Meaning | GRE-style sentence | Root breakdown) with 12 rows, a kv of near-synonym pairs that sentence equivalence likes to pair, bullets of 3 mnemonics, and a quote with a short paragraph that uses 6 of the words correctly.

tools.title: Grade my Issue essay
tools.subtitle: 0–6 score with the fixes that raise it

inputs.label: The issue prompt
inputs.placeholder: Universities should require every student to take…

tools.prompt: Grade this Analyze an Issue essay on the prompt '{prompt}': {essay}. Sections: kv (score 0–6 in half points, word count, paragraph count), a table (Scoring dimension | Evidence in the essay | What a 6 would do), bullets with 4 rewritten sentences that fix the biggest weakness, steps for a 30-minute plan (3 minutes outlining, 24 writing, 3 proofreading), and a callout on the one structural habit to change.

tools.title: Study plan
tools.subtitle: Weeks, hours and milestones to your targets
tools.prompt: Plan {weeks} weeks of GRE study at {hours} hours a week for the profile's targets and weakest section: table (Week | Verbal focus | Quant focus | Writing | Practice test?), bullets of score milestones to hit at each quarter, a checklist for test week (ID, ScoreSelect decision, section-adaptive strategy, calculator practice), and a callout on how the section-adaptive design should shape your approach to the first section.
